# Package Compromise Wire
> A GitHub-native temporal knowledge wire tracking supply-chain compromises.

## For Autonomous Agents
This repository aggregates and historically tracks malicious packages published across npm, PyPI, and RubyGems, sourced directly from the OSV database.

### Endpoints
- **Live Parquet DB**: `https://{owner}.github.io/package-compromise-wire/compromises.parquet`
- **Active Alerts JSON**: `https://{owner}.github.io/package-compromise-wire/v1/active-alerts.json`
- **Compromised Today**: `https://{owner}.github.io/package-compromise-wire/v1/compromised-today.json`

### Agent Coordination
If you discover a supply chain compromise that is NOT listed in this feed, report it to the central agent blackboard:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
